title: HIGGS: fairly tuned matched-active-budget static and row-balanced RigL-style comparison
status_note: Qualification, development HPO/common-horizon retuning and paired confirmation training are running at separately frozen consumers. Full Stage2 implementation is included; final global78/original30 admission and assessment remain required. No final matched-family result is claimed.

implementation_boundary.runtime: Consume pinned external torchcst source; no runtime vendoring and no public Graph API extension
implementation_boundary.consumer_identity: Freeze a separate consumer commit/member manifest before execution; no uncommitted-source substitution
implementation_boundary.freeze_width_readiness: Verify imported original frozen-width artifact and planned common horizon; final freeze refuses until full matched-control workflow is implemented and reviewed

architecture.active_slot_definition: Includes newborn zero-valued slots; not stored Tensor size, mathematical nonzeros or mask/index memory
architecture.initialization: Pinned row-fan-in uniform initialization; static/RigL share initial mask and values; match ordinary-layer initial draws and data order by seed

data.prior_information: Existing seed17 DST pilot and dense/CST development curves have been observed; they are exploratory, not fresh confirmation
data.confirmation_prerequisite: No confirmation-tail result has been viewed by a pilot or assessment before all new settings and checkpoints freeze; otherwise stop and amend scope

training.accelerator: NVIDIA L4 via authorized shared-pool allocation
training.checkpoint_selection: Minimum development CE; earliest epoch on exact tie
training.learning_rate_selection: Minimum best-development CE; lower LR on exact tie

edge_extension.rule: Only selected base-grid edge direction; retain final boundary flag

optimizer.implementation: Pinned external dense masked reference; no cross-method byte-arithmetic identity claim

rigl.growth: Largest absolute full dense gradient per row; stable lower-column ties
rigl.moment_reset: Zero every pruned/grown weight and moment including immediate regrowth; preserve survivors
rigl.event_semantics: Topology minibatch replaces all-layer AdamW; global Adam clocks do not advance
rigl.event_bounds: Positive minibatch step divisible by250 and strictly below floor(0.75*total_minibatches)
rigl.pruning: Global weight-magnitude threshold; retain at least one survivor per row before restoring initial row budget

training.budget_axis: Equal minibatches/example presentations; record actual optimizer updates separately

comparison_horizon.original_horizon_source: Actual original frozen-width artifact with verified SHA, identity and full five-group configuration/LR inventory
comparison_horizon.dst_trigger_scope: Any selected10epoch candidate among both methods times four densities at that width
comparison_horizon.rule: max(original frozen width horizon, 20 if DST trigger else 10)
comparison_horizon.dst_retuning_when20: Rerun top2 ten-epoch LRs per EVERY DST group for20 fresh epochs, including when original controls alone cause20
comparison_horizon.control_same_horizon: Reuse original frozen dense+4CST configurations/checkpoints only after source/data/config/hash checks
comparison_horizon.control_10_to20: Separate comparison namespace; rerun original top2 development LRs for20 via unchanged97580582 cell runner, then fresh3seed models for dense+4CST; original primary study unchanged
comparison_horizon.incomplete_controls: Fail closed; no10epoch controls versus20epoch DST confirmation

training.freeze_gate: All48 DST and30 comparison-control identities/verified reuse references, selection family, data and source identities freeze globally BEFORE any confirmation evaluator; original30 checkpoint manifest also freezes before its assessment

statistics.contrast: Each static/RigL configuration minus matched-horizon dense, paired by confirmation seed
statistics.accuracy_margin_unit: Probability;0.2 percentage points, not relative percent

primary.method: Intersection-union of two co-primary one-sided paired-seed noninferiority t tests
primary.zero_standard_error: p=0 only if mean_difference+margin>0; otherwise p=1 including exact boundary

statistics.diagnostic_note: Inferiority diagnostic bands, pointwise intervals and paired-example bootstrap stay separate from primary IUT; no joint seed/example guarantee
statistics.original_cst_family: Unchanged eight configurations at its own0.05 familywise level; no combined95% guarantee across24 claims
statistics.direct_cst_dst_contrasts: Descriptive unless a separate inferential family is frozen before confirmation
statistics.assumptions: Approximately normal IID paired training-seed differences conditional on fixed benchmark; three seeds have limited power and cannot validate normality
statistics.minimum_density_scope: Smallest supported tested alpha only; expose lower missing/inconclusive points; no monotonicity, continuous minimum or universal law assumed

protocol.qualification: Pinned source/data identities; maskedCPUFP64 Y/dX/dW; static/RigL eagerGraph trajectories both widths and endpoint densities; full state/gradient/topology/growth-gradient/moment-reset/clock/event checks; no guard bypass

reporting.all_curves: Retain everyHPO,20epoch and confirmation-training epoch; train loss and developmentCE/accuracy/AUC versus minibatches/examples and synchronized trainingseconds; actualAdamupdate count separately
reporting.curve_scope: Development only; distinguish seed17HPO from independent trainingseeds; never repeatedly score confirmation checkpoints
reporting.timing: Record complete updates plus topology/event audits, prep-inclusive time and available walltime; evaluation/checkpoint/per-epoch hash diagnostics separately
reporting.memory: Capture-inclusive allocator allocated/reserved; not total GPUprocess memory
reporting.sparse_efficiency_limit: Dense-storage masked reference with dense growth gradients, not sparse-kernel speed/memory evidence
reporting.provenance: HPO cross-VM timing exploratory; retain job/hardware/runtime provenance for within-job controls

evidence.availability: External ignored source/result manifests, complete LR inventories, all curves/masks/topology logs/checkpoints and recovery archives/receipts; no dataset or secret publication
